task_summary: Implemented POST /api/internal/catalog/listing-state/batch — owner-controlled internal API endpoint for deterministic marketplace listing state writes. Supports 1-100 updates per request with validation, variant resolution, conflict detection, legal status transitions, idempotent retry, raw_payload preservation, and batched PostgREST upserts into platform_listings and platform_listing_skus.
scope_statement: Bounded to the internal API handler in src/api/internal-catalog.ts, one Cloudflare Pages route at functions/api/internal/catalog/listing-state/batch.ts, comprehensive mock-fetch tests in src/api/internal-catalog-listing-state.test.ts, tsconfig update, documentation update, and package.json test script update. No migrations, credentials, databases, networks, deployments, or production access. No unrelated files modified.
commands_or_checks_run: npm run test:internal-api (60 tests, 60 pass, 0 fail)
npm run test:internal-api 2>&1 && npm run typecheck:internal-api 2>&1
npm run typecheck:internal-api 2>&1 && npm run test:internal-api 2>&1
findings: Existing internal-catalog.ts exports two handlers (handleCatalogSkuRequest, handleCatalogInventoryQueryRequest) with constant-time Bearer auth, PostgREST reads, and fail-closed design. New handleListingStateBatch follows the same patterns.
platform_listings has unique(platform, shop_code, external_listing_id); platform_listing_skus has unique(listing_id, sku_position). Both support upsert via PostgREST resolution=merge-duplicates.
product_variants.item_code has a unique index; resolved case-insensitively via ilike PostgREST filters.
Schema expanded by intelligence migration includes listing_status (text, default 'unknown'), raw_payload (jsonb), platform_updated_at (timestamptz), and sku fields on platform_listing_skus.
risks: PostgREST upsert with return=representation returns rows in input order for bulk POST; if this assumption is wrong, SKU listing_id mapping could misalign. Verified via PostgREST docs behavior.
postgrestIn helper escapes double quotes in values; external_listing_ids with double quotes would produce incorrect filters. Low risk — marketplace listing IDs rarely contain quotes.
